"Scientists Discover New Kind of Plastic that Can Heal and Prevent Cancer." There are several types of plastic, but most plastics do not break down in water or air, so they can be recycled indefinitely without harming wildlife or humans who ingest them (the ones with polyethylene). The problem for some people though... it's very hard to recycle these things because there aren't enough good recyclers out there yet! So instead you have an abundance of bad plastic waste being collected at landfill sites all over the world from many different countries across continents where recycling has never been tried before -- including Japan which has had no government regulation on how garbage gets disposed since WWII. This means we're essentially dumping our precious natural resources into this vast ocean of trash by having governments decide what goes into your body when you die. It also causes lots of health problems as well, such as cancer and birth defects due to toxins and other chemicals that get trapped inside even organic matter like wood pulp. The first step was making sure this wasn't going to happen again, but now that we know better than ever... I'd say let's just start using paper bags and reusable bottles/boxes instead.
